definition: Scott Wu (born 10/07/1996) is an American entrepreneur.
details: Multiple-time IOI gold medalist who led the creation of Devin, the first widely deployed autonomous AI software engineering agent. He is the co-founder of Cognition AI and Lunchclub. Wu is also a competitive programmer who won three gold medals (placing first in 2014) at the International Olympiad in Informatics (IOI) and took third place in the 2021 Google Code Jam.

explainer.lead: Scott Wu is an American computer programmer and entrepreneur.

contributions.name: In 2017, Wu co-founded Lunchclub and was its CTO until 2022 when he left to pursue different interests.
In 2023, Wu co-founded Cognition AI which developed Devin AI.

timeline.what: Wu was born in 1997 in Louisiana to a Chinese immigrant family.
He also competed in Mathcounts and became individual champion in 2011.
From 2014 to 2015, Wu worked as software engineer at Addepar.
Wu was listed in 2020 edition of Forbes 30 Under 30 for co-founding Lunchclub.
